name: The Wishing Book
source:
Between her job as a weaponsmith, a slew of nonstop dungeon-venturing commissions, and the responsibility of taking care of her younger brother, Beatrice lives a life of exhaustion and unrest. After yet another tiring day of tedium, she discovers a magic book that hides a horrible secret...
